items.title: 52263_Sonny Greer oral history interview
items.q: And the Captain -- I called him Captain. Beautiful guy.

ctx.x: Well, Duke usually came every night because he was downstairs in the cafe where we lived. Duke lived there, we all lived there. Duke would be having one of his dreams and he saw where Ray could fit in the band. Ray played trumpet and the violin, that was it. And sing. You know, Duke was on the lookout for everything. Duke gobbled him right up.
And the Captain -- I called him Captain. Beautiful guy.
Let me see, you had for a little while -- there was some guys in the band you didn't talk about last time.
